messages:
maya-cs: Quick alert 12 Sapphire Health (HernE1n) requested a short pilot on our MX edge for tomorrow. Ask: mex1 region, IP allowlist 187.46.33.0/24, QPS bump to 2600 for 48h, autorevoke after. Theyb4re nearly out of trial credits and mentioned renewal talk this week. Can infra confirm?
liam-eng: @ops-bot please open a provision ticket and run a capacity scan for mex1. Also note model family expected for the demo. Tag me when PR created.
ops-bot: Created provision ticket PR-9921. Initial mex1 capacity scan queued, ETA ~90m. Noted: tenant=sapphire, requested qps=2600, cidr=187.46.33.0/24, duration=48h.
sofia-se: Ib4ll prep KV warmups and an eval harness once region is ready. @hernan-sapphire can you paste 2-3 representative prompts and indicate if they use streaming or full-response mode?
hernan-sapphire: Prompts: (1) "patient: 56M, chest pain x2 days -> differential + next steps" (2) "normalize: 'SOB' -> shortness of breath" Theyb4ll use streaming for the demo. Traffic baseline ~8k tokens/day; demo peaks ~1.6k qps for 10-15s bursts. Renewal call Friday.
liam-eng: If theyb4re on open-redwood-13b-quant we should reserve a capacity slot; fallback to open-redwood-7b-quant acceptable. @maya-cs confirm fallback permitted and whether we should enable prefix caching.
maya-cs: Confirm fallback OK. Please enable prefix/KV caching and tag tenant:sapphire-mex1 for monitoring. Apply allowlist and schedule autorevoke in 48h. Also loop sales for renewal conversation.
liam-eng: Pushing config now. Run command: ```curl -s -X POST https://infra.internal/provision -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tenant":"sapphire","region":"mex1","qps":2600,"duration":"48h","cidr":"187.46.33.0/24","models":["open-redwood-13b-quant","open-redwood-7b-quant"],"cache":"kv_prefix"}'``` Monitoring job PR-9921.
ops-bot: PR-9921 update: capacity reserved on mex1, allowlist applied, cache warmed on route. Autorevoke scheduled at 1752637801. Internal request ID: TLC-1911.
sofia-se: Warmup started: warming 80 seeds across common prefixes. Quick result: pre-warm median latency 460ms -> post-warm 140ms, 95th=220ms. Eval report uploaded to /shared/sapphire/pilot/eval-1752469001.pdf
nora-sales: Looping in sales for renewal touch: @maya-cs can you share the renewal window and whether the client requested committed SLOs? I can prep a proposition.
maya-cs: Renewal window = EOW. Client asked about committed latency if we keep mex1 active post-pilot. Please prepare a draft and I'll present during Friday call.
hernan-sapphire: Thanks all. One ask: enable verbose tracing for the next 6h during the demo so we can capture detailed latency traces. Web4ll send annotated feedback in real time.
liam-eng: Enabled verbose traces for tenant sapphire; exporting traces to dashboards/shared/sapphire/mex1/traces. Added spike markers for demo timeframe.
ops-bot: Reminder: autorevoke notification scheduled 1h before 1752637801. Channel will get a warning and the infra ticket will auto-close after revoke.
maya-cs: Handover documented. Demo prep call 10:00 PT tomorrow with client; renewal sync scheduled for Friday. If any perf regressions, escalate to #eng-oncall and tag me immediately.
